title: CD Projekt Red 2026年上半年利润增长37%
content:
CD Projekt Red sees profit climb 37% in H1 2026 | GamesIndustry.biz

Read our editorial policy
.
CD Projekt Red
generated
$116.5 million (435 million PLN) in revenue during the first half of 2026, up 23% year-over-year.
Net profit also rose 37% to $66.7 million (249 million PLN), and net profitability reached 57.2%.
CD Projekt Red laid out a three-year The Witcher release plan: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt – Remastered launches September 29 on PC, PS5, Xbox Series X/S, and, for the first time, natively on Switch 2, free to existing owners of the base game and including both prior expansions.
A partnership with Blizzard Entertainment will also bring Remastered and the upcoming Songs of the Past expansion to Battle.net.
The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt has now sold more than 65 million copies, with the series overall surpassing 90 million.
Cyberpunk 2077, on the other hand, has crossed 40 million copies sold, and the Phantom Liberty expansion has sold 15 million in under three years, while Night City has appeared in Wuthering Waves and Apex Legends this year, and a Cyberpunk trading card game became the most-funded project in Kickstarter's history.
Cyberpunk: Edgerunners 2, again co-produced with Studio Trigger, is set for Netflix on October 20. CFO Piotr Nielubowicz said licensing "is progressively becoming more important" to the company's results, alongside continued sales from both franchises.
In May, as CD Projekt announced the third expansion for 2015's The Witcher 3, the developer
reported a slight 6% increase in overall revenue to $52.5 million
(PLN 191 million) during its first quarter.
In June, the publisher
CD Projekt announced it was changing its name to CD Projekt Red
.
